sources.title: Introducing Claude
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The March 14, 2023 announcement offers Claude and Claude Instant, describing Instant as lighter, faster and cheaper. It links Claude to Anthropic's helpful/honest/harmless research but states no nominal total, active count, or identity with a named sized research model.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Page 1 identifies Claude 2 and previous Claude models as Transformers. Page 3 names Instant 1.1. Figure 6 (page 7) puts parameter-scaled prior research models in a separate left panel from the Claude score bars on the right; its parameter axis does not assign sizes to Claude Instant. The benchmark table on page 10 contains performance percentages, not total or active counts.

sources.title: Model Pricing (launch-linked pricing sheet)
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The launch-linked one-page pricing sheet lists Claude Instant and Claude-v1 with 9,000-token contexts, per-million-token prompt/completion prices and dedicated capacity availability. None of these numbers is a parameter count; no nominal total or active count is published.

sources.title: Introducing 100K context windows
sources.evidence: May 11, 2023 announcement expands Claude from 9K to 100K tokens and demonstrates Claude-Instant processing 72K tokens. This is a later upgrade, not the original March release specification.

sources.title: Releasing Claude Instant 1.2
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The August 9, 2023 announcement identifies Instant 1.2 as the latest revision and compares it with 1.1. Incorporating strengths of Claude 2 is not an explicit named-base identity, and neither a parameter count nor size-bearing lineage is given for original Instant.

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
sources.evidence: Fetched directly and text-extracted after web reader rejected the PDF as too large. Later comparison tables name Claude Instant 1.2, not the original revision, and contain no numeric Instant model parameter counts. No later sibling size is transferred to this record.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Current API terms grant service access, restrict reverse engineering and retain intellectual-property rights. Used only as corroboration of proprietary service classification, not as the exact historical 2023 contract.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: Official deprecation history separately lists claude-instant-1.0, claude-instant-1.1 and claude-instant-1.2 as retired November 6, 2024.

sources.title: Measuring the persuasiveness of language models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The April 2024 research compares compact Instant 1.2 with frontier Claude models. Its scaling discussion and chart distinguish qualitative model classes and generations; neither supplies a nominal total, active count or named sized base for original Instant.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: Model Card and Evaluations for Claude Models, with Claude 2.1 appendix
sources.evidence: Fresh official PDF retrieved October 27, 2026; independently searched its full extracted text and inspected the model details, Figure 6 and Instant comparison table. Instant 1.1 appears in benchmark comparisons, while the numerical parameter axis belongs to separate prior research models. No Instant nominal total or activated-parameter count is supplied in the card or appendix.

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family, with Claude 3.5 addenda
sources.evidence: Fresh official combined PDF retrieved October 27, 2026; independently searched the complete extracted text for parameter counts, active counts, Instant and lineage, and inspected relevant sections. Tables 5 and 6 compare Instant 1.2 using benchmark percentages. Section 5.8 discusses increasing parameter scale from Haiku to Opus without numerical counts. No total or activated-parameter column or sized-base relationship establishes the original Instant specification.

sources.title: Training a Helpful and Harmless Assistant with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Section 2.3 specifies 52B context-distilled language and preference models used for feedback collection; section 3.1 specifies research sizes from 13M to 52B. Full-text search finds no Claude name. These are valid nominal experimental counts, but the paper supplies no identity connecting a 52B model to commercial Claude Instant.

sources.title: Constitutional AI: Harmlessness from AI Feedback
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Section 3.3 and Appendix D identify 52B experimental SL-CAI, pretrained, HH RLHF and RL-CAI models. Full-text search finds no Claude name; no statement establishes that original Claude Instant is one of these models or a variant with inherited nominal size.

name.note: Retain normalized historical name for the original Instant offering; the launch uses Claude Instant and deprecations distinguish subsequent 1.x identifiers.

developer.note: The developer's announcement introduces its own Claude Instant model.

family.note: Normalized family label; launch presents Instant as one of two Claude versions.

release_date.note: First public offering date stated by the original announcement; May context expansion and August 1.2 revision are later events.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact-model sources document the commercial hosted offering; this classification uses the general distribution policy without transferring technical specifications from newer models.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary classification, supported by non-distribution of Claude weights and commercial hosted access; not a named open-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 searches and primary-source review found no nominal total or explicit sized-base identity for original Instant. Later comparisons identify 1.1 or 1.2 and give benchmark scores. Published 52B RLHF/CAI research counts lack a commercial-Instant identity statement; Figure 6 does not map its research parameter axis to Claude bars.

active_parameters_b.note: Checked active counts separately, including later first-party comparison tables and targeted activated/active-parameter searches. No nominal activated count is reported for original Instant. Transformer architecture and qualitative compactness do not establish an active count or justify equating it with total parameters.

architecture.note: The model card expressly covers Claude 2 and previous Claude models. Dense versus MoE is not established; retain only the stated Transformer classification.

context_window.note: Original offering: launch-linked pricing sheet gives Claude Instant 9,000 tokens. The May 11 announcement separately increased the window to 100K; do not backdate that upgrade.

modalities.note: Launch describes conversational/text-processing interaction; pricing distinguishes prompt and completion tokens. No image, audio or video modality is documented for this release.

reasoning.note: General language and reasoning tasks do not establish a dedicated reasoning-mode capability flag for the original Instant identifier; exact historical support was not verified.

tool_call.note: The original release has no exact-model native tool-call support declaration. The model card's ability to connect Claude to search tools is insufficient to establish structured tool calling.

description.value: Anthropic's original Claude Instant text model, introduced as a faster, lower-cost alternative to Claude.
description.note: Replace the generic historical-release placeholder with the launch's documented positioning.

patch.description: Anthropic's original Claude Instant text model, introduced as a faster, lower-cost alternative to Claude.
patch.notes: This record describes the original March 2023 Claude Instant offering, documented with a 9,000-token context. Anthropic announced a 100K context upgrade on May 11, 2023 and Instant 1.2 on August 9, 2023. Nominal total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; published 52B research models are not identified as this release. Dense-versus-MoE structure remains undisclosed. Claude Instant 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 API identifiers were retired November 6, 2024.

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains explicit null/undisclosed nominal total and active counts. Reopened launch, pricing, Instant 1.2, persuasiveness and original research sources; inspected fresh Claude 2 and Claude 3/3.5 cards and searched for nominal, active and sized-base disclosures. Resolved the 52B lead to research models lacking a commercial-Instant identity and the Claude 2 Figure 6 parameter axis to a separate research panel. Later Instant comparisons report scores, not parameter counts. All nonparameter assessments are preserved.
